title: DP833 Turning Point Prediction for the UK using CSO Leading Indicators
title_zh: 基于CSO先行指标的英国经济转折点预测
title_primary: 基于CSO先行指标的英国经济转折点预测
title_secondary: DP833 Turning Point Prediction for the UK using CSO Leading Indicators
authors: Michael Artis, Samuel Bazzi, Robert Blair, Christopher Blattman, Oeindrila Dube 等
official: 官方在线 1993-09-30 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper examines the performance of alternative models for predicting turning points in the UK growth cycle. The models are based upon an interpretation of movements in the CSO's composite longer and shorter leading indicators. The difference between the models lies in the choice of method adopted for separating and classifying observations into a pattern corresponding to an upturn and downturn regime, together with the decision rule applied in recognizing when a regime shift has occurred. The models involved include a simple mechanical rule based upon an interpretation of consecutive movements in the leading indicator and two probabilistic methods, namely a standard Bayesian model and the sequential probability model developed by Neftci (1982). The results of the exercise suggest that usefulness of the shorter leading index is extremely limited; prediction based upon this series is typically outperformed by naive, non-indicator methods. The information content of the longer leading index appears somewhat greater. The signal extracted by the sequential probability model is particularly well-defined in this respect giving rise to a lead time of between four and six months at peaks and six months for troughs. At horizons beyond six months, however, the sequential probability model is outperformed by a more conventional Bayesian method.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了预测英国增长周期转折点的替代模型的表现。这些模型基于对英国中央统计局（CSO）综合长期与短期先行指标变动的解释。模型之间的差异在于：对观测值进行分离和分类以对应上升与下降阶段模式所采用的方法选择，以及识别阶段转换发生时所应用的决策规则。涉及的模型包括：基于先行指标连续变动解释的简单机械规则，以及两种概率方法——标准贝叶斯模型和Neftci（1982）开发的序贯概率模型。实证结果表明，短期先行指数的实用性极为有限；基于该序列的预测通常被朴素的无指标方法所超越。长期先行指数的信息含量似乎更大。序贯概率模型提取的信号在这方面尤为清晰，在峰值处可提供四至六个月的领先时间，在谷底处则为六个月。然而，在超过六个月的预测区间上，序贯概率模型的表现逊于更传统的贝叶斯方法。

title: Convertible Securities and Venture Capital Finance
title_zh: 可转换证券与风险资本融资
title_primary: 可转换证券与风险资本融资
title_secondary: Convertible Securities and Venture Capital Finance
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2021-11-17 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper offers a new explanation for the prevalent use of convertible securities in venture capital finance. Convertible securities can be used to endogenously allocate cash flow rights as a function of the realized quality of the project. This property can be used to mitigate the double moral hazard problem between the entrepreneur and the venture capitalist. It is shown that an optimally designed convertible security outperforms any mixture of debt and equity and that it can induce both parties to invest efficiently. The result is robust to renegotiation and to changes in the timing of investments and information flows.
abstract_zh: 本文为风险资本融资中可转换证券的普遍使用提供了一种新的解释。可转换证券能够根据项目实现质量内生地分配现金流权，这一特性可用于缓解企业家与风险资本家之间的双重道德风险问题。研究表明，最优设计的可转换证券优于任何债务与股权的组合，并能激励双方进行有效投资。该结论在重新谈判、投资时机及信息流变化的情况下均保持稳健。

title: DP148 Theoretical and Empirical Determinants of International Labour Mobility: A Greek-German Perspective
title_zh: 国际劳动力流动的理论与经验决定因素：希腊-德国视角
title_primary: 国际劳动力流动的理论与经验决定因素：希腊-德国视角
title_secondary: DP148 Theoretical and Empirical Determinants of International Labour Mobility: A Greek-German Perspective
authors: Louka Tarsitsa Katseli, Nicholas P. Glytsos
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Emigration of labour and its subsequent repatriation can best be understood as phases of an intertemporal exchange process, of a relatively abundant factor, namely unskilled labour, for a relatively scarce factor, namely capital. This capital flow initially consists of financial capital, that is of emigrant remittances, and of human capital at the time of repatriation. This analytical hypothesis is empirically tested on Greek data and seems to be validated by the empirical evidence presented. The formulation of the emigration-repatriation cycle as an intertemporal phenomenon highlights the need for forward-looking policies. The analysis suggests that planning for the period of net immigration and of reduced remittances should be an integral component of policy in the sending country.
abstract_zh: 劳动力外迁及其后续遣返，可被理解为一种跨期交换过程的不同阶段——即以相对充裕要素（即非熟练劳动力）换取相对稀缺要素（即资本）。这一资本流动最初表现为金融资本（即移民汇款），并在遣返阶段体现为人力资本。该分析假设基于希腊数据进行了实证检验，且似乎得到了所呈现经验证据的验证。将移民-遣返周期界定为跨期现象，凸显了前瞻性政策的必要性。分析表明，对净移民流入及汇款减少时期的规划，应成为输出国政策不可或缺的组成部分。

title: DP45 Macroeconomic Aspects of the Effectiveness of Foreign Aid: On the Two-Gap Model, Home Goods Disequilibrium and Real Exchange Rate Misalignment
title_zh: 对外援助有效性的宏观经济方面：关于双缺口模型、国内商品失衡与实际汇率失调
title_primary: 对外援助有效性的宏观经济方面：关于双缺口模型、国内商品失衡与实际汇率失调
title_secondary: DP45 Macroeconomic Aspects of the Effectiveness of Foreign Aid: On the Two-Gap Model, Home Goods Disequilibrium and Real Exchange Rate Misalignment
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We construct an open economy disequilibrium model to assess the welfare effects of aid in different macroeconomic regimes. Aid is shown to have different effects in different unemployment regimes because it increases the social costs of wage-price rigidities in the classical regime but decreases them in the Keynesian unemployment regime. A link is made with the two-gap model, but we highlight the role of real exchange rate misalignment (failure to clear the NT goods market).
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个开放经济非均衡模型，以评估不同宏观体制下援助的福利效应。研究表明，援助在不同失业体制中具有差异化影响：在古典失业体制下，援助会加剧工资-价格刚性的社会成本；而在凯恩斯失业体制下，援助则降低此类成本。本文将该模型与双缺口模型建立关联，但着重强调实际汇率失调（即非贸易品市场未能出清）所发挥的作用。

title: Campaign Connections
title_zh: 竞选关系
title_primary: 竞选关系
title_secondary: Campaign Connections
official: 来源期次 American Economic Journal: Economic Policy · 来源：期刊官网
abstract: This paper explores the labor market returns to working for a victorious political campaign. Using unique administrative data from Brazil, we track campaign workers’ employment and earnings before and after close mayoral elections over nearly 20 years. We find sizable returns to working for a winning campaign, especially in areas with large informal sectors and for workers connected to challengers. Returns are concentrated in the public sector, where connected hires are more educationally qualified, including at higher levels of the bureaucracy. Our findings suggest that personal connections, not simply party ties, facilitate the hiring of capable, though inexperienced, civil servants.
abstract_zh: 本文探究了为获胜政治竞选工作所带来的劳动力市场回报。利用巴西独特的行政数据，我们追踪了近20年市长选举前后竞选工作人员的就业与收入情况。研究发现，为获胜竞选工作能带来可观的回报，尤其是在非正规部门规模较大的地区，以及与挑战者存在关联的工人群体中。这些回报主要集中在公共部门，其中通过关系入职的人员在学历资质上更为优秀，甚至包括更高层级的官僚机构。我们的研究结果表明，个人关系（而非单纯的党派联系）促进了有能力但缺乏经验的公务员的聘用。

title: A Simple Model of Government Decision-Making and Plurilateral Cooperation on Critical Materials
title_zh: 政府决策与关键材料多边合作的简单模型
title_primary: 政府决策与关键材料多边合作的简单模型
title_secondary: A Simple Model of Government Decision-Making and Plurilateral Cooperation on Critical Materials
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We develop an integrated framework to characterize multi-objective policymaking and apply it to the case of critical materials. The model considers that national policy decisions will be influenced by domestic agencies with different priorities and goals and be informed by actions taken by other countries pertaining to critical materials. This creates a potential basis for a group of countries to form a critical materials club to reduce the probability of supply shocks and/or their consequences. We show that in an environment with multiple policy-active governments, criticality assessments embedded in a multi-objective government with domain-specific bureaucracies and multiple instruments can rationalize divergent policy choices under similar risk environments, provide conditions under which international coordination is more or less likely and apply the model to consider the design and political economy of plurilateral arrangements for critical materials.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个综合框架来描述多目标政策制定过程，并将其应用于关键材料案例。该模型认为，国家政策决策将受到具有不同优先事项和目标的国内机构的影响，并参考其他国家在关键材料方面采取的行动。这为一批国家组建关键材料俱乐部、降低供应冲击概率及其后果提供了潜在基础。研究表明，在存在多个政策活跃政府的背景下，嵌入多目标政府（包含特定领域官僚机构与多种政策工具）的关键性评估机制，能够解释相似风险环境下政策选择的差异性，揭示国际协调更易或更难实现的条件，并运用该模型探讨关键材料诸边安排的设计与政治经济学逻辑。

title: What Happens to Contractors After States Ban Affirmative Action?
title_zh: 各州禁止平权行动后，承包商面临何种变化？
title_primary: 各州禁止平权行动后，承包商面临何种变化？
title_secondary: What Happens to Contractors After States Ban Affirmative Action?
official: 官方在线 2026-06-22 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Using restricted Census business records, I explore how banning affirmative action in state contracting affects minority- and women-owned business enterprises (MWBEs). I find that ending affirmative action led MWBE contractors to gradually downsize, with the most pronounced reductions in force experienced by Black-owned businesses and larger MWBEs. Despite these workforce changes, existing MWBEs were no more likely to shut down than other businesses. New MWBEs were relatively less common after a state's ban, highlighting how bans can shift the demographic composition of new contractors. A calibrated model suggests bans are equivalent to considerable reductions in MWBE productivity and scrap values.
abstract_zh: 利用受限的人口普查商业记录，本文探讨了禁止州政府合同中的平权行动对少数族裔和女性所有企业（MWBEs）的影响。研究发现，终止平权行动导致MWBE承包商逐渐缩减规模，其中黑人所有企业和规模较大的MWBE企业裁员幅度最为显著。尽管劳动力结构发生变化，现有MWBE企业的倒闭概率并未高于其他企业。在州禁令实施后，新成立的MWBE企业相对较少，这表明禁令可能改变新承包商的人口构成。校准模型显示，禁令相当于大幅降低MWBE的生产效率和残值。

title: Financial Liberalizations, Booms, and Crashes
title_zh: 金融自由化、繁荣与崩溃
title_primary: 金融自由化、繁荣与崩溃
title_secondary: Financial Liberalizations, Booms, and Crashes
authors: Maximilian Grimm, Moritz Schularick, Emil Verner
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Financial liberalization is often seen as a way to deepen credit markets and stimulate economic growth, but it may also fuel credit booms that end in crisis. We construct a new cross-country database of banking regulation policies covering 21 regulatory indicators for 18 advanced economies since World War II. We distinguish liberalizations that directly relax constraints on credit supply from broader financial reforms. Liberalizations that directly affect credit supply lead to substantial expansions in private credit. Credit expansion is concentrated in non-tradable sectors and is not accompanied by higher interest rates or credit spreads in the short run, consistent with an outward shift in credit supply. Real GDP rises over the following 2 to 4 years, but the gains are temporary. On average, GDP returns to trend in the medium run, and there is an increase in the risk of financial crisis and worse downside growth outcomes. Only liberalizations that directly expand credit supply generate these boom-bust dynamics. Based on these estimates, financial liberalization is welfare-improving for coefficients of relative risk aversion below 7.2, a moderately high value.
abstract_zh: 金融自由化常被视为深化信贷市场、刺激经济增长的途径，但也可能助长最终引发危机的信贷繁荣。我们构建了一个涵盖二战后18个发达经济体21项监管指标的新跨国银行业监管政策数据库。我们将直接放松信贷供给约束的自由化措施与更广泛的金融改革加以区分。直接影响信贷供给的自由化措施会导致私人信贷大幅扩张。信贷扩张集中于非贸易部门，且短期内并未伴随利率或信用利差的上升，这与信贷供给曲线外移的特征一致。实际GDP在随后2至4年内有所增长，但这种收益是暂时的。平均而言，中期内GDP回归趋势水平，同时金融危机风险上升，经济增长下行风险加剧。只有直接扩大信贷供给的自由化措施才会产生这种繁荣-萧条动态。基于这些估算，当相对风险厌恶系数低于7.2（一个中等偏高的数值）时，金融自由化能够提升社会福利。

title: Deadly Stigma
title_zh: 致命污名
title_primary: 致命污名
title_secondary: Deadly Stigma
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: How harmful is stigma in the “real world”? Answers are elusive because stigma is difficult to measure in observational data, and isolating its effects requires exogenous variation in stigma without variation in the stigmatized trait. This study addresses these challenges by focusing on a widespread form of stigma — weight stigma — in the high-stakes setting of inpatient healthcare. BMI categories are displayed prominently to providers in electronic medical records, and obesity is heavily stigmatized socially. Thus, at the "obese" cutoff, stigma may shift discretely while the underlying trait (BMI) does not. Using a regression discontinuity design that exploits this institutional feature, I find a discontinuous increase in in-hospital mortality at this cutoff, though patient health does not change. Two patterns suggest stigma-based discrimination as the mechanism. First, just-obese patients receive less diagnostic effort than almost-obese patients. Second, a physician-validated LLM identifies at the cutoff a rise in stigmatizing language in clinical notes — specifically, language that imposes moral judgment, undermines patient credibility, and stereotypes patients — among the most stigmatizing providers, who also drive the mortality result. Overall, these results suggest that stigma is a powerful social force with potentially life-or-death consequences.
abstract_zh: 污名在“现实世界”中有多有害？答案难以捉摸，因为污名在观测数据中难以衡量，且分离其影响需要污名本身的外生变化，而污名化特征保持不变。本研究通过聚焦住院医疗这一高风险场景中普遍存在的污名形式——体重污名，来应对这些挑战。电子病历中BMI类别被显著展示给医疗服务提供者，而肥胖在社会中受到严重污名化。因此，在“肥胖”临界点处，污名可能发生离散变化，而潜在特征（BMI）并未改变。利用这一制度特征，采用断点回归设计，我发现该临界点处院内死亡率出现非连续上升，尽管患者健康状况并未变化。两种模式表明污名化歧视是作用机制：首先，刚达肥胖标准的患者获得的诊断努力少于接近肥胖的患者；其次，经医生验证的大语言模型识别出，在临界点处临床记录中污名化语言有所增加——具体而言，是施加道德评判、削弱患者可信度及对患者进行刻板印象的语言——这些语言主要来自污名化程度最高的医疗服务提供者，而他们也正是死亡率上升结果的驱动因素。总体而言，这些结果表明污名是一种强大的社会力量，可能带来生死攸关的后果。

title: The Easterlin Paradox at 50
title_zh: 50年后的伊斯特林悖论
title_primary: 50年后的伊斯特林悖论
title_secondary: The Easterlin Paradox at 50
authors: Oparina, Ekaterina, Clark, Andrew, Layard, Richard
official: 官方在线 2026-06-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We use Gallup World Poll data from over 150 countries from 2009-2019 at both the individual and country levels to revisit the relationship between income and subjective wellbeing. Our inspiration is the paradox first proposed by Easterlin (1974), where higher incomes are associated with greater happiness in cross-sections, yet rising country GDP per head does not necessarily increase its average wellbeing. In our analysis subjective wellbeing (or happiness) is measured by the Cantril ladder on a 0-10 scale. Across individuals, other things equal, one unit of log income raises subjective wellbeing by 0.4 points. In other words, doubling income raises wellbeing by 0.3 points out of 10. Across countries, a crude regression of wellbeing on log per capita income gives a higher coefficient of 0.6. But, once social variables like health and social support are introduced, the picture changes. In rich countries, income no longer has a significant independent effect, either in country cross-sections or in time series. For low-income countries the result is also clear cut - income raises happiness in both cross-section and time series, whether the social variables are controlled for or not. For middle-income countries the result is mixed.
abstract_zh: 我们利用2009-2019年间覆盖150多个国家的盖洛普世界民意调查数据，从个体和国家两个层面重新审视收入与主观幸福感之间的关系。研究灵感源于伊斯特林（1974）首次提出的悖论：在横截面数据中，较高收入与更高幸福感相关，但国家人均GDP增长未必能提升其平均福祉水平。本研究中，主观幸福感（或幸福感）采用坎特里尔阶梯量表（0-10分制）进行测量。在个体层面，其他条件不变时，对数收入每增加一个单位，主观幸福感提升0.4分。换言之，收入翻倍可使幸福感在10分制中提升0.3分。在国家层面，对幸福感与人均对数收入进行简单回归，得到0.6的更高系数。然而，一旦引入健康与社会支持等社会变量，情况便发生变化。在富裕国家，无论是国家横截面数据还是时间序列数据，收入均不再具有显著的独立效应。对于低收入国家，结果同样明确——无论是否控制社会变量，收入在横截面和时间序列中均能提升幸福感。而中等收入国家的结果则呈现混合特征。

title_zh: 社会项目参与对第三代的持续影响
title_primary: 社会项目参与对第三代的持续影响
title_secondary: Persistent Effects of Social Program Participation on the Third Generation
authors: Gordon B Dahl, Anne C Gielen
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-27 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Can participation in safety net programs have long-lasting negative effects across multiple generations? We take advantage of a 1993 Dutch disability insurance reform which tightened requirements and lowered benefits for participants. We study the third generation 25 years after the reform, finding that grandchildren of individuals whose DI eligibility and benefits were reduced are less likely to be born premature, have low birthweight, or experience complicated deliveries. They also have better health and schooling outcomes during early childhood. These early-life improvements are consequential, as they have been linked to better health, education, and labor market outcomes in adulthood.
abstract_zh: 参与安全网项目是否会对多代人产生长期负面影响？我们利用1993年荷兰伤残保险改革这一契机，该改革收紧了参保条件并降低了福利水平。我们研究了改革25年后的第三代群体，发现其伤残保险资格和福利被削减的个体的孙辈，早产、低出生体重或出现分娩并发症的概率更低。他们在幼儿期的健康和教育成果也更为优异。这些早期生命阶段的改善具有深远影响，因为已有研究表明其与成年后更佳的健康、教育及劳动力市场表现相关联。
